subject: Confession: I built this at 2AM
preview_text: This isn't a typical email. I messed up with my own dog, and it led to PupShape. Read the full story inside.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this, but I have to tell you something raw. At 2AM, after my own dog, Buster, hit 85 pounds and could barely chase a ball, I sat at my laptop, frustrated and guilty. I had no idea what to feed him, how much, or if I was making things worse.

That night, I built the first version of PupShape. It wasn't pretty. But it worked. Buster dropped 15% of his weight in 8 weeks, and his vet said his joints looked years younger. I realized the problem wasn't lack of love—it's lack of clear, simple science. That's why every meal plan in PupShape is vet-approved and tailored to your dog's breed, age, and weight.

You already have the app, but I bet you haven't used the Before/After photo timeline. That's the feature I built for owners like us—to see the transformation happen, week by week. It's not about perfection. It's about progress. One photo, one meal, one walk at a time.

Open PupShape right now and snap a before photo. Then set your dog's first milestone. I promise, seeing that timeline fill up will change everything. P.S. Most dogs see their first real drop in weight after 2 weeks on the plan—don't give up before then.
cta_text: Open PupShape and snap your dog's before photo
